_readme: Per-slug abstraction-pass config (#259 iter 5), consumed by abstract-glb.mjs — distinct from overrides-chatt.json (runtime placement). keepAll: skip context culling entirely (bridges: a 700m deck is geometrically indistinguishable from a context plane, so the grant is the contract). maxExtentM: expected post-cull XZ extent — QC badges and the extents test only flag above it. dropFlatContext:false disables the heuristic rules for one slug. dropNodes: case-insensitive regex list matched against source node names, removed pre-flatten (surgical escape hatch). lodRatios: {lod1,lod2} per-slug simplify keep-ratio overrides.

arriving-home-by-dennis-oppenheim._why: riverfront art installation — a genuinely long, low piece; the cull guard correctly refused to treat it as context

celestial-clockwork-by-rey-alfonso._why: public art — mostly-flat by nature; guard-abort is correct, grant silences it

market-court-chattanooga-tn._why: low court/plaza model — guard-abort is correct, grant silences it

at-t-field-model._why: node 2668 is the whole neighborhood baked into ONE 425×39×288m mesh (too tall for the sheet heuristic, unsplittable) — drop by name; the stadium itself is node 2670 (~161m)

the-chattanooga-carnegie-law-library._why: Image is a flat 83×79m ground-photo plane; the rest is small pieces scattered across the block (extent = spread, not a sheet)

the-chattanooga-convention-center._why: the convention center genuinely is ~290m long

bluff-view-art-district._why: deliberately a district sample (multiple small buildings)

poise-by-angela-conner._why: sculpture garden spread along the riverfront

unum-provident._why: full-block office campus (was 479m pre-cull; the 174m remainder is the real complex)

warehouse-row._why: it IS a row — ~174m of connected warehouses
